sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Brucebase: the tags kept on a show's On stage page were not found for shows with a long address (101 shows). The wiki cuts a page name to 60 characters, and "onstage:" is four characters longer than "gig:", so such a show's On stage page has a shortened name ("…-red-bank-n"). It was asked by its full name, not found, and the cast's tags were missing from the Tags card, the preview window and the year table's Tags column.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase tag check: the wiki's two icons are checked too. A show marked with the Help Us icon should carry the tag "help", one marked with the Featured star "featured"; a show with neither icon should carry neither tag. A missing one is listed as "help missing" (❌), one without its icon is marked ⚠️, with the reason, in the same two findings as the date, day letter, kind and premiere tags.

On a year table and a year listing the icons come with the page, at no cost. A show's own page and its preview window read the show's year page once for them, at the press or on Space (one more request, kept like every year page); with both tag findings switched off it is not read.
The Featured star is recognised by its picture, also where the wiki gives it no title (12 shows).

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Every stored preview of a page on another site, and every stored Brucebase year page, is read once more (both readers now keep the icons).
